verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for an accounting SaaS like sevDesk, but the evidence pack never documents a conversational or agentic assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The automatic booking-category suggestion and automatic asset recognition are adjacent automation features, not an assistant that accepts delegated tasks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
